summary: Texts shown to players, per language. Each has a key and an English default. You can set your own text for any language, and add keys for your own content. A player sees the text in their game's language (player.language), then the server's English text, then the default. Placeholders such as {thief} are filled in by name.

defaultLanguage.summary: The language used when a player's language has no text: 'english'.

defaults.pickpocket.victimNotice.summary: Default text of the notice a pickpocket's victim sees.

defaults.items.maxTooltip.summary: Default tooltip for an item's carry limit.

defaults.items.limitReached.summary: Default text for reaching an item's carry limit.

defaults.stash.inUse.summary: Default text shown mid-screen when a container is open for another player.

set.summary: Sets your texts for a language. An empty text returns a key to its default.

params.texts: An object of keys and texts.

set.exampleLua:
local Locales, Chat = kcds.core.Locales, kcds.core.Chat

Locales.set("czech", { ["shop.welcome"] = "Vítej v obchodě, {name}!" })
Chat.sendToPlayer(player, Locales.text(player, "shop.welcome", { name = player.nickname }))
set.exampleCs:
Locales.Set("czech", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["shop.welcome"] = "Vítej v obchodě, {name}!" });
Chat.SendToPlayer(player, Locales.Text(player, "shop.welcome", new { name = player.Nickname }));

get.summary: A key's text in a language: your text, then your English text, then the default, or undefined if there is none.

text.summary: A key's text in a player's game language, with placeholders filled in, or the key itself if there is no text.
text.example:
const { Locales, Chat } = kcds.core;

Chat.sendToPlayer(player, Locales.text(player, 'shop.welcome', { name: player.nickname }));
text.exampleLua:
local Locales, Chat = kcds.core.Locales, kcds.core.Chat

Chat.sendToPlayer(player, Locales.text(player, "shop.welcome", { name = player.nickname }))
